name: zenborg-garden-glyphs
source: the .svg files beside this spec; code copies their paths verbatim, never redraws them
color: currentColor, stone tones only (see ../DESIGN.md, Garden Glyph Rule)

meaning.plant: a sprout: two leaves off a young stem
meaning.harvest: an ear of grain, leaning, heavy with kernels
meaning.fence-standing: a picket fence, closed: a standing fence
meaning.fence: two pickets with the rail running on into the gap: a timed fence, the gate opens
meaning.fence-gate: a gate swung open: a pause gate you pass through
meaning.phase-morning: the sun rising over the horizon, with rays
meaning.phase-evening: the sun setting: a low cap over the horizon

rule: Stroke-only, no filled marks. Garden marks are plants and fences; phases are the sky over the garden: sun rising, sun high, sun setting, moon.
defaultsOnly: Phase glyphs are the default only when a phase has no user emoji. Phase emoji are user-owned (Settings) and stay.
archive: phi-archive/ holds the geometric φ-grammar set that was tried first and rejected as not organic enough.
